description:
Activate Opposition by tapping Emmara, targeting Emmara.
Emmara triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
The Soldier enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Opposition ability, tapping Emmara.
Emmara triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
The Soldier enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
